policy.publicNames: __all__ when present, otherwise non-underscore module attributes; NLTK-owned classes and routines (including bound tokenizer helpers) are targets. Other attributes are listed as exclusions, not silently dropped.
policy.classMembers: Public callable members are discovered, including inherited members. Mapping a class does not map all its members.
policy.bunExports: Runtime value exports of every package.json Bun entrypoint. Type-only exports and nested namespace members are excluded; name presence is not behavioral evidence.
policy.behavior: Evidence is case-scoped, never full parity. Existing tests are references, not a record that the generator executed them. Unreviewed names default to gaps.

excludedModules.reason: Desktop GUI and demos are not supported algorithms; exported throwing shims do not change this.
Tk drawing/UI is outside the selected headless compatibility scope.
Conversation demos and namespace members have not received a behavioral review.
Network integrations and demos have not received an integration review.
Except the explicitly selected WordNet reader: data lazy loaders and other reader formats need per-reader/data inventory.
Except chart: Earley, feature/dependency, external parsers and generation require separate member/signature review.
Except sequential/perceptron: Brill, HMM, TnT, CRF and external taggers require separate review.
Except selected common stemmers: language-specific standalone stemmers need rule and fixture review.
Except BLEU/ChrF/NIST: IBM1-5, alignment, METEOR, RIBES, LEPOR and decoder members need separate review.
Logic/DRT/glue/semantic integrations require their own signatures and differential evidence audit.
Provers and external prover integrations need per-engine evidence audit.
CCG types, combinators and chart parser need per-member audit.
KMeans/EM/GAAC need algorithm and numerical fixture audit.
Brill rule/template training needs per-member audit.
Misc demos/algorithms are not in the selected compatibility contract.

All other modules, NLTK root reexports, constants/imported third-party helpers, type-only Bun exports, nested Bun namespaces and Python dunder protocols are explicitly outside this release inventory. Selected module public names still list attribute exclusions. No whole-NLTK coverage percentage is computed.
